ms.criteria:
1. The course design must include 12 lectures, each focused on a specific dApp topic. The design for each lecture includes:
・Description of the dApp and the logic of the on-chain code
・Necessary theoretical content to be integrated into the lecture

2. Lectures 1 & 2 must be accessible on the Learning Management System. Each lecture must include:
 a. A lecture video and a written lecture material, covering the following:
・An introduction to the necessary theoretical content
・A detailed analysis of the dApp and its components: on-chain, off-chain code
・Additional reference materials, if availab
ms.report:
1. The course content design is available on GitHub: Vietnamese version , English version
The course is structured into 12 modules, corresponding to 12 dApp topics:
・Secret Number
・Vesting
・Swap
・Membership NFT
・Multisig Treasury
・Marketplace
・Betting
・P2P Lending
・Stablecoin (VNDC)
・Crowdfund
・Auction
・CIP-68 NFT Minting

The course has been published on Cardano2VN LMS under the title: "Building with Aiken - Lập Trình DApp Cardano Thực Chiến"
The Course Content (Roadmap) is available on the course overview page.

2a. The first two modules of the course have been published on the LMS, including both written lessons and video lectures. You may need to enroll in the course to access the full content.
・Module 1 — Secret Number (3 lessons):
・Exploring the Secret Number Game
・On-chain Code
・Frontend & Off-chain
・Module 2 — Vesting (3 lessons):
・Introduction to the Vesting Problem & Time Theory on Cardano
・Building a Vesting Smart Contract with Aiken
・Building the Off-chain & Frontend for the Vesting dApp with MeshJS

The lecture videos are also publicly available on the YouTube playlist.

2b. The source code for the first two modules is available in the course github repository.
・Secret Number dApp
・Vesting dApp

3. Course promotional posts have been published on the Cardano Forum and in Vietnamese Cardano developer Telegram groups.
Details are available in the Marketing Evidence file.
